items.summary: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is announcing the availability of the latest major release of the MOtor Vehicle Emission Simulator (MOVES) model, MOVES6. MOVES6 is the latest version of the EPA's state-of-the-science modeling tool for estimating emissions from cars, trucks, buses, and motorcycles based on the latest data and regulations. MOVES6 is available for use in State Implementation Plans (SIPs) and transportation conformity analyses. This notice starts a two-year grace period before MOVES6 will be required for use in transportation conformity determinations, both in new regional emissions analyses and in new hot-spot analyses.
items.title: Official Release of the MOVES6 Motor Vehicle Emissions Model for SIPs and Transportation Conformity

This notice invites comment on a proposed information collection project titled 2026 Ebola Passenger Disclosure and Attestation. The purpose of this information collection is to ensure that, consistent with the terms of a pending Order under the Public Health Service Act, public health authorities in the United States can confirm that individuals have not been present in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in the 21 days before arriving in the United States.

items.summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), a component of the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), announces it is issuing an Order under Sections 361, 365, 368, and 369 of the Public Health Service Act, and associated implementing regulations, prohibiting the boarding of any passenger who is not otherwise subject to an exemption on any aircraft destined to the United States from a foreign country unless the passenger presents a signed attestation confirming the passenger has not been present in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) during the 21 days prior to boarding a flight to the United States. This Order was issued on October 22, 2026, to become effective at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time (EST) on November 3, 2026, and shall remain in effect through 11:59 p.m. EST on December 18, 2026. This Order may be amended or rescinded prior to that time at the discretion of the Secretary or his designee.
